017package org.apache.juneau.server.config.repository;
018
019import java.io.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.commons.logging.*;
022import org.eclipse.jgit.api.*;
023import org.eclipse.jgit.api.errors.*;
024import org.eclipse.jgit.internal.storage.file.*;
025import org.eclipse.jgit.lib.*;
026import org.eclipse.jgit.transport.*;
027
028
029/**
030 * Git repository control operations for cloning, pulling, pushing, and committing.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Provides a simplified wrapper around JGit for server configuration repository management.
034 * Used to fetch configuration files from a remote Git repository.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * The underlying JGit {@link Repository} and {@link Git} handles are opened in the constructor and released by
038 * {@link #close()}, so instances must be used with try-with-resources to avoid leaking file/native handles.
039 */
040public class GitControl implements AutoCloseable {
041
042   private final String localPath;
043   private final String remotePath;
044   @SuppressWarnings("resource") // Owned by this AutoCloseable; released in close().
045   private final Repository localRepo;
046   @SuppressWarnings("resource") // Owned by this AutoCloseable; released in close().
047   private final Git git;
048   private final CredentialsProvider cp;
049   private final boolean forcePush;
050
051   /**
052    * Constructor.
053    *
054    * <p>
055    * Equivalent to {@link #GitControl(String, String, String, String, boolean) GitControl(localPath, remotePath,
056    * null, null, false)}: no credentials (anonymous transport) and non-force push.
057    *
058    * @param localPath Local directory path for the repository.
059    * @param remotePath Remote Git repository URI.
060    * @throws IOException If the repository cannot be opened.
061    */
062   public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath) throws IOException {
063      this(localPath, remotePath, null, null, false);
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Constructor.
068    *
069    * <p>
070    * Credentials are supplied by the caller (typically from operator configuration or a secret store) rather than
071    * hardcoded.  Pass {@code null} for {@code username} to use anonymous transport.
072    *
073    * @param localPath Local directory path for the repository.
074    * @param remotePath Remote Git repository URI.
075    * @param username Git username, or <jk>null</jk> for anonymous transport.
076    * @param password Git password/token.  Ignored when {@code username} is <jk>null</jk>.
077    * @param forcePush Whether {@link #pushToRepo()} performs a force-push (destructive remote history rewrite).
078    *    <br>Force-push is opt-in; defaults to <jk>false</jk> in the other constructors.
079    * @throws IOException If the repository cannot be opened.
080    */
081   @SuppressWarnings({
082      "resource" // localRepo (FileRepository) and git (Git) are long-lived fields closed in close(); Git wraps the externally-created Repository without closing it, so both are released there. Warnings surface at the constructor assignments (lines 84/87).
083   })
084   public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath, String username, String password, boolean forcePush) throws IOException {
085      this.localPath = localPath;
086      this.remotePath = remotePath;
087      this.localRepo = new FileRepository(localPath + "/.git");
088      this.cp = username == null ? null : new UsernamePasswordCredentialsProvider(username, password);
089      this.forcePush = forcePush;
090      git = new Git(localRepo);
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Closes the underlying JGit {@link Git} and {@link Repository} handles.
095    *
096    * <p>
097    * The {@link Git} instance wraps an externally-supplied {@link Repository} (it does not close it on
098    * {@link Git#close()}), so both are released explicitly here.
099    */
100   @Override
101   public void close() {
102      git.close();
103      localRepo.close();
104   }
105
106   /**
107    * Stages all files for commit.
108    *
109    * @throws GitAPIException If staging fails.
110    */
111   public void addToRepo() throws GitAPIException {
112      var add = git.add();
113      add.addFilepattern(".").call();
114   }
115
116   /**
117    * Checks out the specified branch from origin.
118    *
119    * @param name Branch name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
120    * @throws GitAPIException If checkout fails.
121    */
122   public void branch(String name) throws GitAPIException {
123      git.checkout().setName(name).setStartPoint("origin/".concat(name)).call();
124   }
125
126   /**
127    * Clones the remote repository to the local path.
128    *
129    * @throws GitAPIException If clone fails.
130    */
131   public void cloneRepo() throws GitAPIException {
132      // call() returns a Git handle wrapping the freshly-cloned repo; the clone (working tree on disk) is the
133      // side-effect we want, so close the returned handle immediately to avoid leaking file/native handles.
134      try (var g = Git.cloneRepository().setURI(remotePath).setDirectory(new File(localPath)).call()) {
135         // No further operations needed on the cloned handle.
136      }
137   }
138
139   /**
140    * Commits staged changes with the specified message.
141    *
142    * @param message Commit message.
143    * @throws JGitInternalException If an internal JGit error occurs.
144    * @throws GitAPIException If commit fails.
145    */
146   public void commitToRepo(String message)
147      throws JGitInternalException, GitAPIException {
148      git.commit().setMessage(message).call();
149   }
150
151   /**
152    * Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository.
153    *
154    * @throws GitAPIException If pull fails.
155    */
156   public void pullFromRepo() throws GitAPIException {
157      git.pull().call();
158   }
159
160   /**
161    * Pushes all committed changes to the remote repository.
162    *
163    * @throws JGitInternalException If an internal JGit error occurs.
164    * @throws GitAPIException If push fails.
165    */
166   public void pushToRepo() throws JGitInternalException, GitAPIException {
167      var pc = git.push();
168      if (cp != null)
169         pc.setCredentialsProvider(cp);
170      // Force-push is opt-in (see constructor); a destructive remote history rewrite is never performed by default.
171      pc.setForce(forcePush).setPushAll();
172      try {
173         var it = pc.call().iterator();
174         if (it.hasNext()) {
175            Logger.getLogger(GitControl.class).info("{}", it.next().toString());
176         }
177      } catch (InvalidRemoteException e) {
178         Logger.getLogger(GitControl.class).warning(e, "Error pushing to remote repository.");
179      }
180   }
181}
